item.title: Twista Pleads Guilty to $440K in Tax Evasion Charges & Faces Up to 5 Years in Prison
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our music news update. Today, we're talking about Chicago-based rapper Twista, who's in hot water with the IRS. Let's dive into the details."
[Music transitions to a brief clip of Twista's song]
Host: "Twista, whose real name is Carl Mitchell, has pleaded guilty to five counts of willfully failing to pay taxes between 2019 and 2023. According to court documents, he owes the IRS over $440,000 in back taxes and could face up to five years in prison."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "The charges break down to one year in prison and a $25,000 fine for each count. Twista's tax liabilities include $18,891 for 2019, $5,715 for 2020, $32,571 for 2021, $71,703 for 2022, and $49,103 for 2023. And that's not all - he also has unpaid tax liabilities from 2011 to 2018, totaling hundreds of thousands of dollars."
[Music transitions to a brief pause]
Host: "The IRS claims that Twista received over $578,000 in advances on future royalties, but instead of using the funds to pay his taxes, he bought luxury cars, including a BMW, Tesla, Corvette, and Jeep Gladiator, worth hundreds of thousands of dollars."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "Twista rose to fame in the early 2000s with his speedy rapping and breath control, topping the Billboard 200 with his 2004 album Kamikaze. He's also had several top 10 hits, including 'Slow Jamz' and 'Overnight Celebrity'. He's set to be sentenced on October 22nd."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's update. We'll keep an eye on this story and see how it unfolds. Thanks for listening!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
